seo.title: Weigh Easy — Private Weight Tracker for iPhone and Apple Watch
seo.description: A private weight tracker. Type your weight, see the trend under the daily ups and downs, set a goal, and keep progress photos on your iPhone. Pounds, kilograms or stones, Apple Health, Apple Watch and widgets. No accounts, no tracking.

hero.label: WEIGHT TRACKER
hero.title: Your weight, without the noise.
text: Type your weight and see where it’s really heading. A calm trend line, a goal without pressure, and progress photos that stay on your iPhone. No account, no cloud, no tracking.

sections.label: FEATURES
sections.title: Everything you need, nothing you don’t.

items.title: Weigh in by typing
items.text: Type “182.4”, “82.5 kg” or “13 st 4 lb yesterday after a run” at the bottom of Today. Weigh Easy shows what it understood before it saves anything.

items.title: A trend you can trust
items.text: A smoothed trend line that evens out water and food swings. Several weigh-ins on one day count as their average, and days you skip are skipped, not guessed. The trend in plain words: “Down 1.2 lb a week”.

items.title: Goals without pressure
items.text: Set a goal weight, with a date if you like. See how much is left, how far you’ve come, and roughly when you’d get there at this pace.

items.title: Pounds, kilograms or stones
items.text: Switch any time. Every weight is kept exactly, so switching never changes your history, and stones read as stones and pounds.

items.title: Private progress photos
items.text: Take or add progress photos and compare any two side by side. They stay inside Weigh Easy on your iPhone, out of your photo library and iCloud, with an optional Face ID lock.

items.title: Apple Health, Apple Watch and widgets
items.text: Optionally save your weigh-ins to Apple Health and bring in your smart scale’s. Add a weigh-in from your wrist, and see your trend on your Home Screen and Lock Screen.

sections.label: PRIVACY
sections.title: Your body, your data.
text: Weight is personal. Weigh Easy never collects, uploads or shares it. No account, no analytics, no tracking. Your weigh-ins stay on your device, and progress photos stay inside the app, left out of backups unless you choose to include them.

cta.title: Start with one weigh-in.
cta.text: Free on the App Store. No account required.
